title: Course: CS 284B | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: Course: CS 284B | EECS at UC Berkeley CS 284B. Advanced Computer Graphics Algorithms and Techniques Catalog Description: This course provides a graduate-level introduction to advanced computer graphics algorithms and techniques. Students should already be familiar with basic concepts such as transformations, scan-conversion, scene graphs, shading, and light transport. Topics covered in this course include global illumination, mesh processing, subdivision surfaces, basic differential geometry, physically based animation, inverse kinematics, imaging and computational photography, and precomputed light transport.
